items.title: WhatsApp Introduces Optional Account Password Feature to Strengthen Login Security
items.description: WhatsApp has released a new Android update through the Google Play Beta Program, bringing the version up to 2.26.7.8. The update reveals that WhatsApp is actively developing an optional account password feature designed to add another layer of security on top of the existing two-step verification (2FA) system. items.title: $10K+ Bounty Offered to Hacker Who Can Disconnect Ring Video Doorbells from Amazon Cloud
items.description: A newly launched bug bounty program is offering nearly $18,000 to anyone who can successfully disconnect Ring Video Doorbells from Amazon’s cloud servers while keeping the devices fully functional. items.title: Google Chrome Emergency Security Update Patches Three High-Severity Vulnerabilities
items.description: Google has released a critical security update for its Chrome browser, pushing version 145.0.7632.116/117 to Windows and macOS users, while Linux users receive version 144.0.7559.116. The update, which is rolling out progressively over the coming days and weeks, addresses three high-severity vulnerabilities that could expose users to significant risk if left unpatched.
